integrity: Scientific proof and finite independent-style algebraic regression checks are provided; no claim of external or independent validation is made.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-index coefficient asymptotic and Gaussian law are standard supercritical-sequence consequences and are not represented as original. The new statements concern iterated n then j limits, not simultaneous n,j growth. No uniform-in-j error bounds or nonpositive weights are established; priority outside inspected sources remains uncertain.
title: A large-index phase profile for monomial perturbations of Euler's partition product
